title: The Real Reason You Crave Sweets After Stress
hook: Your sweet cravings after stress are a survival mechanism.

narration.text: Your sweet cravings after stress are a survival mechanism.
When you are stressed, your body releases cortisol.
Cortisol makes you desire sugary, fatty foods.
These foods provide a quick energy boost and comfort.
It is your body's attempt to restore balance quickly.
Recognising this helps you choose healthier coping strategies.
Does this happen to you? Comment your thoughts, like if it surprised you, and subscribe for more insights.

description: Ever wondered why you reach for chocolate after a tough day? It is not just about willpower. This short explains the surprising science behind your stress-induced sweet cravings and how your body tries to cope.
topic: Why you might feel a sudden craving for something sweet after a stressful day. This is your body's comfort mechanism.
